evidence: Hor. Ep. 1.2.18: ūtile prōposuit nōbīs exemplar (of Ulysses)
terms.comment: Something or someone set up to be imitated: ad imitandum … prōpositum exemplar (Cic. Mur. 66, Lewis & Short). Traupman gives it for “model” and “role model”.

evidence: Sen. Ep. 6.5: breve et efficāx per exempla
Tac. Germ. 7.1: ducēs exemplō potius quam imperiō
terms.comment: exemplum sūmere, to take as a model (Ter. Ad. 416).

phrases.latin: vōs exemplāria Graeca nocturnā versāte manū, versāte diurnā
phrases.english: study the Greek models: turn their pages by night, turn them by day

phrases.latin: īnspicere tamquam in speculum in vītās omnium jubeō, atque ex aliīs sūmere exemplum sibi
phrases.english: I tell him to look into everyone’s life as into a mirror, and to take from others a model for himself

phrases.latin: longum iter est per praecepta, breve et efficāx per exempla
phrases.english: the road through rules is long; through examples it is short and effective

sources: Lewis & Short: exemplar · Lewis & Short: exemplum
